ATLAS QUANT / RESEARCH PLATFORM

Ideas meet
historical evidence.

A small quantitative research lab. Turn a trading rule into an experiment, measure its risk, and see how it compares with simply holding the market.

Open the research lab ↗

Historical simulation · SPY daily data · 2020–2025

01 / FORM A HYPOTHESIS

Start with a rule.

Does positive recent momentum persist? Choose a lookback and let a simple rule decide when to own the asset.

02 / TEST IT FAIRLY

Give it a benchmark.

Use the same asset, dates, starting capital, and costs for a buy-and-hold comparison.

03 / LOOK PAST RETURN

Understand the risk.

Inspect drawdown, volatility, and risk-adjusted performance. Save the evidence behind the result.

BUILT TO LEARN

Research, one experiment at a time.

This first release includes a reusable backtesting engine, historical SPY data, two strategies, and a local experiment archive. Every calculation is explained in the lab.

Historical performance is evidence about a selected past period, not a forecast. Strategy Arena and Market Map are future projects.
